claims.label: computable Schoen Serre constituent category

claims.label: complete cover Ext screen

claims.label: complete invariant Ext cocycle screen
claims.statement: All 1,440 pairs have exact invariant subcomplexes; 1,080 positive spaces have explicit cocycle representatives and 360 vanish exactly.

claims.label: partial exact automorphism quotient classification
claims.statement: Exactly 1,296 of 1,440 pair actions are certified; the sweep is suspended because larger remaining spaces cannot simplify pair 73.

claims.label: structural automorphism trichotomy
claims.statement: Observed actions divide into direct scalar, quotient-reduced scalar, and square-zero-unipotent exceptional families; a family-level proof is absent.

claims.label: pair 73 universal P3 extension parameter space
claims.statement: Pair 73 has four exact invariant cocycles and scalar constituent automorphisms, so its nonzero orbit parameter space is P3 over Q(omega).

claims.label: pair 73 universal invariant Ext family
claims.statement: The four exact pair-73 cocycles assemble linearly over Q(omega)[a0,a1,a2,a3]; only the affine origin splits and the nonzero automorphism quotient is P3.

claims.label: universal rank-four mapping-cone family
claims.statement: All four pair-73 classes lift through exact projective-product Cech descent into degree-one morphisms of the full resolution; their universal linear combination has an exact derived cone.

claims.label: rank-four algebraic lawful locus
claims.statement: Every nonzero pair-73 class is a locally free descended rank-four extension with trivial determinant and fixed Chern data; local freeness and descent exclude no additional parameter.

claims.label: pair-73 unavoidable stability walls
claims.statement: The rank-two extension subbundle, its Serre line, and the rank-three preimage give exact necessary slope inequalities; their region intersects the published Kahler cone, while the full family is unstable at the published carrier anchor.

claims.label: pair-73 slope-stable locus
claims.statement: The right Serre line lifts through every pair-73 outer extension and has slope opposite to the left rank-two subbundle, so strict stability fails at every polarization and parameter.

claims.label: minimum-dimensional computable stability block
claims.statement: All 72 four-dimensional invariant-Ext families in candidates 3 and 23 share the lifted right-Serre-line opposite-slope obstruction.

claims.label: six/eight-dimensional computable stability block
claims.statement: All 72 families in candidates 14 and 34 lift a right Serre line whose exact slope is strictly positive throughout the Kahler cone.

claims.label: eight/ten-dimensional computable stability block
claims.statement: All 72 families in candidates 8 and 28 contain a descended left Serre line whose exact slope is strictly positive throughout the published Kahler cone.

claims.label: coefficient-positive forced-subobject topology class
claims.statement: A structural screen of all 40 declared topology blocks finds 18 blocks, containing 648 families, with an unavoidable subbundle of strictly positive slope throughout the Kahler cone.

claims.label: mixed-sign minimum necessary stability chamber
missing_prerequisites: classification of every additional saturated subsheaf
claims.statement: Candidates 15 and 35 have an exact nonempty common chamber for their three extension-independent subobjects; the rational families (2,1,t) and (1,2,t), with t greater than 7/2, certify nonemptiness.

claims.label: mixed-sign minimum full stability block
claims.statement: Every invariant class in candidates 15 and 35 restricts trivially to the right Serre line, which therefore lifts with strictly positive slope throughout the Kahler cone.

claims.label: dimension-42/48 lifted-line slope-identity block
claims.statement: All 72 families in candidates 16 and 36 lift the right Serre line; a strictly positive linear combination of its slope and the rank-three preimage slope makes their common chamber empty.

claims.label: dimension-50/52 right-line lifting kernel
missing_prerequisites: stability classification on the nonlifting open complements
claims.statement: All 72 families in candidates 4 and 24 have exact rank-20 restriction maps. Their projective lifting kernels are unstable, while stability on the nonlifting open complements remains unresolved.

claims.label: dimension-50/52 necessary stability chamber
missing_prerequisites: classification of additional saturated subsheaves on the nonlifting open complements
claims.statement: Candidates 4 and 24 have a nonempty exact chamber for every extension-independent proper subbundle. Rational factor-exchanged witnesses certify necessity without proving full stability.

claims.label: dimension-50/52 generator-line lifting strata
missing_prerequisites: restriction maps for lower proper constituent sublines
claims.statement: All 288 equivariant quotient-generator line restrictions have exact positive rank and proper kernels. Their finite unstable union leaves a nonempty generic complement.

claims.label: Wilson-projected carrier spectrum
claims.statement: Pair 73 is unstable and no replacement computable family has a parameter-dependent cohomology and Wilson-projected spectrum certificate.

claims.label: first frozen computable carrier
claims.statement: No candidate has passed every rank, determinant, topology, local-freeness, descent, stability, and spectrum gate.

claims.label: current curvilinear Chern-type route
claims.statement: The declared curvilinear rank-four topology has quotient index zero and cannot meet the required carrier target.

claims.label: declared projective Tier A outer route
claims.statement: All six declared projective ray pairs have zero invariant Ext-one classes in that finite presentation category.

claims.label: carrier-specific common DGA package
claims.statement: Generic DGA, module, contraction, and HPL engines exist, but no synchronized carrier complex and physical representatives are available.

claims.label: published tree-level holomorphic flavor structure
claims.statement: The exact published one-Higgs tree texture and its rank-two/null structure are represented, conditional on the selected reference carrier.

claims.label: first carrier-derived 3x3 holomorphic Yukawa matrix
claims.statement: No complete matrix has been evaluated from generated carrier chain data.

claims.label: Ricci-flat, HYM, and matter metric package
claims.statement: Generic section machinery exists, but carrier cocycles, section bases, global-generation proof, and converged metrics are absent.

claims.label: canonically normalized physical Yukawas
claims.statement: Canonical-normalization laws exist, but holomorphic matrices, positive metrics, and a common stabilized context do not.

claims.label: physical worldsheet Pfaffians
claims.statement: Seed conic embeddings, restrictions, determinant-line maps, and normalization are absent.

claims.label: descended stable hidden bundle
claims.statement: The exact hidden target is known, but polynomial maps, descent, local freeness, stability, restrictions, and spectrum are absent.

claims.label: controlled stabilized common vacuum
claims.statement: The symbolic vacuum engine exists, but the complete physical K, W, f, D package and compatible hidden sector do not.

claims.label: measured low-energy observables
claims.statement: Measurements are terminal comparison data and are not admitted as geometry, carrier, rank-lifting, or vacuum selectors.

claims.label: held-out low-energy predictions
claims.statement: No parameter-free low-energy masses, mixings, or CP invariants have been derived from a common stabilized carrier state.
